description: Time remapping (Layer > Time): enable or disable it, Freeze Frame at a time, Freeze On Last Frame (extend the layer to the composition end holding its last frame), hold one frame between two times and then resume, or set Time Remap keyframes saying which source time shows at each composition time (as the Layer panel's remap marker does)

action.description: enable, disable, freeze_frame (at), freeze_on_last_frame, hold (from, to), set_keyframes (keyframes)

at.description: freeze_frame: the frame to hold. Seconds, or "current_time" (the default), "comp_start" or "comp_end"

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

from.description: hold: composition time (seconds) whose frame is held

hold.description: Hold this frame until the next keyframe

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

to.description: hold: composition time (seconds) where playback resumes

name: remap_layer_time
title: Remap Layer Time
